visual.label: visual learner
visual.description: We learn best through visual information such as charts, diagrams, and images. They prefer concepts to be represented pictorially, and often think in images.
visual.environment: A bright space with visual aids, whiteboards, charts, and few visual distractions. They thrive in an environment where information is clearly presented.

auditory.label: auditory learner
auditory.description: Learn best through listening and oral instructions. I prefer discussions, lectures, and explaining information out loud to understand and remember it.
auditory.environment: A quiet space where you can speak out loud or listen to audio without being disturbed. Benefits from environments that allow for discussion and verbal processing.

kinesthetic.label: kinesthetic learner
kinesthetic.description: We learn best through direct experience and physical activity. I prefer to learn by doing, moving, and handling materials.
kinesthetic.environment: A flexible space to move, use hands-on tools and relax. You learn best in an active environment that allows for physical participation.

reading.label: Read/Write Learner
reading.description: We learn best through reading and writing. Prefer to process information through text-based information, note taking, and writing.
reading.environment: A quiet, comfortable space with adequate lighting for reading and writing. Prefers an environment with access to books, paper, and writing utensils.
